sanskrit: saiṣā bhīmā brahmagavy aghaviṣā kṛtyā kūlbajam āvṛtā sarvāṇy asyāṃ krūrāṇi sarve ca mṛtyavaḥ sarvāṇy asyāṃ ghorāṇi sarve ca puruṣavadhāḥ ||
english: This is she — the dreadful brahmin's cow, filled with the poison of sin, the sorcery-spell wound round a reed-bundle; in her dwell all cruelties and all deaths; in her dwell all terrors and all slayings of men.

sanskrit: sā brahmajyaṃ brahmagavy ādīyamānā mṛtyoḥ paḍvīśa ā dyati | meniḥ śatavadhā hi sā brahmajyasya kṣitir hi sā ||
english: She, the brahmin's cow, when she is taken from one who has wronged a brahmin, flies straight into the snare of Death; for she is wrath carrying a hundredfold slaughter — she is indeed the ruin of the brahmin-wronger.

sanskrit: tasmād vai brāhmaṇānāṃ gaur durādharṣā vijānatā | vaiśvānara udvītā mahādevo 'pekṣamāṇā vajro dhāvantī hetiḥ śaphān utkhidantī ||
english: Therefore the cow of the brahmins is not to be assailed by one who knows; she has Vaiśvānara as her breath upward, she is Mahādeva watching over her, she is the thunderbolt running, the missile tearing up with her hooves.

sanskrit: kṣurapavir īkṣamāṇā mṛtyur hiṅkṛṇvatī | vāśyamānābhi sphūrjati brahmagavī brahmajyam ||
english: With a razor-edged wheel as she surveys, Death as she lows — the brahmin's cow, as she bellows, thunders down upon the brahmin-wronger.

sanskrit: ugro devaḥ pucchaṃ paryasyantī sarvajyāniḥ karṇau varīvarjayantī rājayakṣmo mehantī menir duhyamānā śīrṣaktir dugdhā | sedir upatiṣṭhantī mithoyodhaḥ parāmṛṣṭā śaravyā mukhe 'pinahyamāne ||
english: The fierce god is she who swishes her tail — total loss as she shakes her ears — royal consumption as she urinates — wrath as she is milked — headache as the milk is drawn; when she rises up she is mutual strife — when her mouth is stopped she is the arrow-shot.

sanskrit: ṛtir hanyamānā vyṛddhir hṛtā- -aghaviṣā nipatantī tamo nipatitā | anugacchantī prāṇān upa dāsayati brahmagavī brahmajyasya ||
english: As she is struck she is affliction — as she is dragged away she is utter decline — as she swoops down she is the poison of evil — as she falls she is darkness fallen; following after, the brahmin's cow enslaves the breath-forces of the brahmin-wronger.

sanskrit: vairaṃ vikṛtyamānā pautrādyaṃ vibhājyamānā devahetir hriyamāṇāmatir hitā nirṛtir nihitā | pāpmādhidhīyamānā pāruṣyam avadhīyamānāprajastāvihitā ||
english: As she is cut up she is enmity — as she is apportioned from grandchildren onward she is the god-hurled weapon — as she is carried off, bewilderment is set in place and Nirṛti is established; as evil is heaped upon her, cruelty is placed upon her — sterility is implanted.

sanskrit: gharmaḥ paryādhīyamānā vaiśvānaraḥ parihitā viṣaṃ prayasyantī takmā prayastā | mūlabarhaṇī paryākriyamāṇā kṣitiḥ paryākṛtā ||
english: As she is encircled she is the sacrificial heat — Vaiśvānara is wrapped all around her — as she is sent forth she is poison — as she is dispatched she is the fever-sickness; as she is turned about she is the uprooter of roots — destruction is turned all around.

sanskrit: aghaṃ pacyamānā parābhūtiḥ pakvā | sugudhriyamāṇāśīviṣa uddhṛtāsaṃjñā gandhena ||
english: As she is cooked she is evil-ripening — when fully cooked she is utter overthrow; as she is tended and stirred, she is the venomous serpent drawn forth, unconsciousness by her very smell.

sanskrit: abhūtir upahriyamāṇā parābhūtir upahṛtā | śarvaḥ kruddhaḥ piśyamānā śimidā piśitā ||
english: As she is brought near she is non-being — when brought near she is complete destruction; as she is minced, she is Śarva in his wrath — when minced to pieces she is demon-slaughter minced.

sanskrit: ārtir aśyamānā vīkarto aśitā | aśitā lokāc chinatti brahmacārī brahmajyam asmāc cāmuṣmāc ca ||
english: As she is eaten she is affliction — when eaten she is utter dismemberment; eaten, the brahmacārin cuts the brahmin-wronger off from this world and from yonder world.
